mapper.select: SELECT tp.trainer_id AS trainerId, u.name, tp.specialty, uf.file_path AS profileImageUrl, COUNT(p.participation_id) AS courseCount FROM participations p JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = p.course_id JOIN trainer_profiles tp ON tp.trainer_id = c.trainer_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = tp.user_id LEFT JOIN upload_files uf ON uf.target_id = tp.trainer_id AND uf.target_type = 'PROFILE' GROUP BY tp.trainer_id, u.name, tp.specialty, uf.file_path ORDER BY courseCount DESC LIMIT 1;
